title: Password reset must invalidate all user sessions
content: INVARIANT: any password reset or forced sign-out MUST delete every live session belonging to that user, not just one. Implemented as ResetPassword(userID) in session.go: it scans the session map and deletes every session whose User matches userID. New admin/force-signout paths MUST reuse this rule. Forgetting invalidation re-opens the account on stolen devices.
